static_traits.name: 魏亚特
static_traits.social_status: Has some friends to discuss general problems with, but has not yet discussed this specific trouble with them
static_traits.medical_history: No notable physical illness; has not previously received psychological counseling; no similar problem experiences
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively good logic, able to self-reflect; high cooperation, positive attitude but slightly nervous; able to collaborate with the counselor on cognitive restructuring

basic_info.main_problem: I feel disappointed and frustrated after watching horror movies; they often start well but end stupidly, ruining the whole experience, which makes me hesitant to explore new movies.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because my disappointment with horror films affected my enjoyment of my hobbies and leisure time.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, the client missed a deadline during an especially stressful project, and since then has had difficulty keeping up with progress and began to show marked self-doubt; work performance was affected, with difficulty concentrating and a long-term sense of increased stress, and relationships with colleagues became strained. Although the client received praise and awards from the boss, the client still found it hard to believe this positive feedback, often feeling that the missed deadline canceled out the achievements.

A few months ago, he began watching horror films as a hobby and gradually found that many films 'start well but end badly', so after watching, he felt strong disappointment and frustration and hesitated to explore new films. To avoid disappointment, he tried selecting films by consulting reviews and recommendations, but the problem was not resolved and the leisure experience was affected.

special_situations.event: 在工作中错过截止日期
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete tasks on time, it means I am incompetent / I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to improve time management and asking colleagues for help to make up for shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure; I will never do this job well

special_situations.event: 获得老板的表扬与奖项
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is an obvious flaw (such as missing a deadline), then all positive feedback does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Emphasizes negative evidence, downplays or negates positive outcomes to maintain consistency of self-standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These compliments are not credible; missing a deadline cancels out all good results

special_situations.event: Watching a horror movie: the beginning is good but the ending is poor
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the ending is not perfect, the whole movie is ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Before watching, extensively reads reviews and recommendations to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The ending was so bad that the movie was completely ruined

special_situations.event: 准备探索新的恐怖电影
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am let down again, my leisure time will be wasted and I will feel worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 犹豫并回避尝试新影片
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我肯定会再次被电影辜负

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and competent at work, and to gain satisfaction and enjoyment in leisure
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure and being negated; fears imperfection will cause own worth to be wholly negated
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of disappointment or negation by maintaining strict self-standards and negating positive feedback
Gaining a sense of certainty through black-and-white evaluation
Maintaining emotional stability and avoiding frustration again by avoiding exploring new films

object_relations.object_representation: A strictly judging other who will ultimately negate oneself (such as a supervisor/colleague)
Movies/creators that are initially appealing but ultimately disappointing

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others give positive feedback or praise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think these evaluations are not genuine or are offset by negative events (transference: regarding external feedback as unreliable judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, emphasizes negative evidence, uses 'but / nevertheless' to negate positive feedback and weaken the meaning of achievements.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing works of uneven quality or with poor endings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Divides things into 'all good or all bad', not acknowledging middle ground and complexity (transference: simplifying complex experiences into extreme evaluations)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses absolute language (such as 'completely' and 'thoroughly'), insists on a binary evaluation framework, and avoids discussing details where positives and negatives coexist.

manifestations: The leisure activity (watching films) experience is 'ruined' by judging the ending, making it hard to gain satisfaction from the hobby
Difficulty accepting the positive parts, the meaning of experience is covered by negative details
outcomes: Hesitation about and avoidance of exploring new films
休闲生活的满足感下降

manifestations: Reducing freedom to choose and explore new movies due to 'worrying about being let down'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Difficulty believing external praise and awards, self-denial dominates
When encountering negative details, being overly harsh on oneself, ignoring positive information

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Forming a rigid standard of 'must finish on time, otherwise unqualified'
Judging works and self-performance with 'should/must' type rules

positive_force: Willing to participate in and cooperate with counseling, positive attitude
Having received boss praise and awards, indicating a good foundation of ability
Has already tried time management and asking colleagues for help, possessing some willingness to cope and improve
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking and mental filtering tendencies are obvious, easily negating positive evidence
High expectations and excessive harsh criticism lead to disappointment and frustration
Self-doubt and fear of failure prompt avoiding exploring new films
Stress increases and attention declines, affecting work and relationships

target_behavior.behavior: After watching horror films, experiences strong disappointment and frustration, and avoids exploring new films
antecedent: 观看恐怖电影且结尾not佳
When considering watching a new horror movie, worries about being let down again
target_behavior.core_reason: Holds high expectations for work quality and endings, accompanied by all-or-nothing thinking and mental filtering, regarding the negative parts as the basis for wholesale negation
target_behavior.function: Escaping negative emotions and disappointment again, maintaining emotional stability and a sense of certainty
target_behavior.consequence: Enjoyment of leisure and entertainment is impaired; hesitant to explore new films

target_behavior.behavior: Strong self-deprecation and self-doubt at work due to missing a deadline
antecedent: Experiencing a stressful project and missing the deadline
When facing falling-behind progress or heavy tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Uses all-or-nothing thinking and mental filtering in performance evaluation, treating flaws as evidence of total failure
target_behavior.function: Gains a psychological sense of control over imperfection through self-criticism and avoids facing complex evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Attention declines, stress increases, relationships with colleagues are affected, and work performance is impaired
